sources.entry: Resizr - MacOS application for creating AppIcon for iOS and Android apps.

summary.one_liner: Resizr is a macOS app for generating iOS app icon sets and iOS asset sizes from a source image, with Android icon support still planned.
summary.what_it_does: Resizr is a macOS application that creates AppIcon sets for iOS apps. Its TODO list marks iOS Icon Set Support and iOS Asset Resizing as done, and asking the user for a save location as done. Android icon set support is listed as not yet implemented, though the README's intro says Android is "coming soon." A planned check for source image size (ideally 1536x1536 PNG, with a warning otherwise) is unchecked. The README does not describe the user interface or the exact input and output formats beyond these points.
use_cases: prepare app icons for App Store submission
create AppIcon files on a Mac
export icon sizes for Xcode projects
notable: Generates iOS AppIcon sets and resized iOS assets
Asks for a save location when exporting
Open to pull requests for contributions
caveats: Android icon set support is not yet implemented (listed as coming soon and unchecked in TODO)
No image size validation yet; the check for 1536x1536 PNG is still a TODO
UI improvements are still on the TODO list
keywords: create app icons from one image
